text: The doctor went in, and after a few minutes returned to the landing again, where Oak and the parson still waited. “It is all done, indeed, as she says,” remarked Mr. Granthead, in a subdued voice. “The body has been undressed and properly laid out in grave clothes. Gracious heaven—this mere girl! She must have the nerve of a stoic!” “The heart of a wife merely,” floated in a whisper about the ears of the three, and turning they saw Bathsheba in the midst of them.
